owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

dismissal, correction and adjudication are events
a finding never discloses a record its reader has no permission for in the source's scope (SO-F-01)
docs/ORGANISATIONAL-INTELLIGENCE.md defines the finding as a capped claim and the three events
tasks.description: The intelligence layer should not become an unbounded inference engine. The graph (src/engine/graph.mjs) already holds claims with status (fact, theory, conjecture, contested, refuted) and provenance, promoted and demoted as evidence arrives. A finding is such a claim with source event links, affected entities, scope and time context and confidence, whose evidence-derived status is capped at theory; fact needs a person's event or a verification record; ordinary claims keep today's rule. Conflict detection, precision and recall and decision routing are SO-F-13.

criteria.statement: a finding is a graph claim with links to its source events and versions, the affected entities and owners, the scope and time context and a confidence; its evidence-derived status is capped at theory; fact needs a person's event or a verification record; ordinary claims keep the promotion rule of src/engine/graph.mjs; the test attempts promotion of a finding by evidence alone and by a stub session and asserts theory both times

title: SO-F-09 Finding model for organisational intelligence: a finding is a graph claim capped at theory by evidence, promoted to fact only by a person or a verification, with dismissal, correction and adjudication events and no disclosure beyond the reader's permissions
request: Build layer of the Scope One programme, adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026 (fold id SO-F-09) and validated against memev main at d1c65ef. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository; they are cited by id only. Implements the design records SO-2.04 (Cross-project intelligence: evidence-backed discovery across otherwise independent work); SO-2.01 (Organisational knowledge model: relationships between people, teams, projects, decisions, artefacts and evidence) (contracts/scope-one/specs). The decision record cites this contract by id and keeps only the gaps this one does not cover. Memev contracts that land first: SO-F-01, SO-F-02. Page: docs/ORGANISATIONAL-INTELLIGENCE.md comes from the federation architecture documentation (PR #223, branch docs/federation-architecture, not on main); until that merges, the first contract to need a page creates it with its Status section, labelled planned or architectural target, and the later ones extend it. Source in the fold: #222 section 13.6 (evidence-led and cautious; dismissal and correction) and #223 ORGANISATIONAL-INTELLIGENCE.md (evidence and authority). Settled decisions this contract follows (owner decision 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md): topology is local-first and the cloud is only a relay and a backup; every supported provider stands on equal footing and no work or tier depends on one; crdt-merge is reached only through the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs (docs/EXTENSION-POINTS.md) and this contract adds no merge engine to the core; tiers follow docs/PRICING.md (Free core, Personal for up to 3 computers with no per-computer add-on, higher tiers by contacting us) with no Personal trial; the git backup keeps running every few minutes (sync.interval_min). Memory authority: ADR 7 (memory and project-state authority) is proposed in PR #325 and is not decided here; this contract cites it and the local-first decision, and keeps one store under the vault with no second database. Provenance: adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026. Changes: (1) converted from the vault task format to the memev spec format (named tests run as red-green checks on the own test file of the contract; inline regular expression flags became the flags key; hygiene and decision verifiers became commands or doc checks). (2) removed fold-only fields and the owner-decision marker field, reworded the stop rule that named a patent, and made the text pass the leak scan. (3) The fold said the graph holds claims with status fact, theory and conjecture; src/engine/graph.mjs has five (fact, theory, conjecture, contested, refuted). The cap applies to promotion to fact; contested and refuted stand as the graph derives them. (4) Boundary with PG-10.1 WP10-01 and WP10-02 (knowledge status lattice and status fields): the lattice of a fact is owned there. This contract defines only what a finding is and its cap, and maps the cap into the lattice (at most corroborated) once it lands.
